task.description: Implement IDN-01 user registry in backend code according to src/design/idn-01-user-registry.md. Build identity user model and persistence/service layers, expose admin API for create-user with platform-assigned UUID user_id and created_at, enforce unique username conflict -> 409, enforce invalid email -> 422, reject caller-provided user_id/created_at fields, support ACTIVE/INACTIVE status lifecycle, and integrate auth middleware so token-authenticated requests for INACTIVE users return 401. Add any required additive migration(s) only. Keep engine transition logic pure and avoid SQL interpolation.
acceptance_criteria: IDN-01 acceptance criteria are implemented in code paths and error mapping
INACTIVE user status is enforced in auth middleware with HTTP 401 behavior
No SQL interpolation of user input

result.summary: Implemented IDN-01 user registry backend with new identity registry/service/route modules, additive users-table migration for username+ACTIVE/INACTIVE status, create-user API invariants (platform-assigned user_id and created_at, duplicate username conflict, invalid email and forbidden caller fields mapped to 422/409), and auth middleware enforcement that token-authenticated INACTIVE users are rejected with HTTP 401.
